overloadMerges.note: type and specifics are documented with the '←' arrow (values returned by the command), not '→'; auto-parse defaulted both to direction 'in'. Also records the documented QR Output Destination constants for 'type' as sentinelValues.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves the current output destination type of the report for area, plus any type-specific detail (e.g. output file pathname) in specifics.
